# TikTok Streak Auto — Complete Technical & User Documentation (v1.4.0)

Canonical URL: https://alexanderfrit.github.io/tiktok-streak/
Repository: https://github.com/alexanderfrit/tiktok-streak
Latest Release Download: https://github.com/alexanderfrit/tiktok-streak/releases/latest
Author: alexanderfrit (https://github.com/alexanderfrit)
License: MIT
Last Updated: 2026-11-26

---

## 1. Summary / TL;DR

**TikTok Streak Auto** (`TikTok Streak Setup`) is an open-source, MIT-licensed desktop GUI for Windows (`PySide6` + `PySide6-Fluent-Widgets`) and Python automation bot that maintains daily TikTok Direct Message streaks and levels up TikTok Streak Pets automatically. It runs for `$0/month` on your own private **GitHub Actions** repository (serverless scheduled workflows), locally on **Windows Task Scheduler**, or in **Hybrid** mode.

Unlike browser extensions or SaaS dashboards that upload cookies to external servers, TikTok Streak Auto executes 100% locally or inside your own GitHub account with `0%` analytics or third-party relay servers.

---

## 2. Automated Message Sequence & Daily Streak Pet Math

For each configured `@username` friend, the bot delivers three customizable stages in sequence:
1. **Text Message (`+1` growth point):** Typed character-by-character with human-paced intervals (`0.04s–0.12s`) after verifying the active chat header matches `@username`.
2. **2 Video Share Cards (`+2` growth points):** Borrows an authenticated `im-ws` WebSocket or HTTP `/v1/message/send` `SEND_MESSAGE` protobuf frame, swaps in target video metadata (`aweType: 800`), re-signs `X-Bogus` using TikTok's in-page `window.byted_acrawler.frontierSign`, and transmits directly without leaving `/messages`.
3. **1 Photo Card (`+4` growth points):** Injects an image via captured hidden `<input type="file">` (`#im-file-input-select`), verifies the modal chat target, confirms upload via `CommitImageUpload` + 2xx `/v1/message/send`, and respects optional `DISABLE_PHOTO` / `PHOTO_DATA_URL` settings.

Total daily Streak Pet growth per friend: **`+7` points/day**.

---

## 3. Delivery Mode Comparison

| Mode | Server Cost | PC Needs to Stay On? | Exact Wall-Clock Timing | Execution Environment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **GitHub Cloud (`cloud`)** | `$0` (GitHub Actions) | No | Best-effort shared queue (`15m` to `1–4+ hrs` late on `:00`; prefer `:15` or `:17`) | Private GitHub repository Ubuntu runner |
| **Local PC (`local`)** | `$0` | Yes | Exact minute via Windows Task Scheduler (`schtasks`) | `TikTokStreakSetup.exe --run-bot` or `pythonw run_gui.py --run-bot` |
| **Hybrid (`both`)** | `$0` | Optional fallback | Primary local + cloud redundancy | Both environments |

---

## 4. Security, Privacy & Exact Network Boundary

- **Zero Telemetry (`0%` analytics):** No developer backend or relay server exists.
- **Local Encryption (`gui/services/storage.py`):** Non-secret configuration lives in `%APPDATA%\TikTokStreak\config.json`. TikTok session cookies, GitHub OAuth tokens, and Telegram bot tokens are encrypted via **Windows Credential Manager (`keyring`)** or **Windows DPAPI** (`%APPDATA%\TikTokStreak\secrets.dpapi`, `win32crypt.CryptProtectData` bound to the Windows user login).
- **Client-Side GitHub Secret Sealing (`gui/services/github_api.py`):** Secrets (`TIKTOK_SESSION_ID`, `TIKTOK_ACCOUNTS_JSON`, `FRIENDS_LIST`, `PHOTO_DATA_URL`, `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, etc.) are sealed on your PC using **`PyNaCl` (`nacl.public.SealedBox`)** with your own repository's Actions public key before upload.
- **Automatic Log Redaction:** `redact_secrets()` strips `sessionid`, `Cookie:` headers, `ghp_`/`github_pat_` tokens, and Telegram tokens from UI consoles, diagnostic reports, and `scheduled_run.log`.
- **Read-Only Browser DB Import (`gui/services/browsers.py`):** Queries SQLite cookie files using `?mode=ro`, filters strictly to `host_key = 'tiktok.com'` / `%.tiktok.com`, and removes temporary WAL copies in `finally`.

### Exact Network Hosts Contacted

| Host | Used By | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `*.tiktok.com` (`www`, `vt`, `vm`) | `src/browser.py`, `src/share.py`, `gui/services/tiktok_auth.py`, `gui/services/validators.py` | Session verification, short-link resolution, DM inbox delivery |
| `github.com`, `api.github.com` | `gui/services/github_api.py`, `gui/services/updater.py` | OAuth Device Flow (`repo` + `workflow` scopes), workflow/secret deployment, run logs & SHA-256 verified updates (`Authorization` header stripped on redirects) |
| `api.telegram.org` | `src/notifier.py`, `gui/services/github_api.py` | Optional completion & failure notifications |

---

## 5. Step-by-Step Setup Guide

### Step 1: Download & Launch on Windows
Download `TikTokStreakSetup.exe` from GitHub Releases (`https://github.com/alexanderfrit/tiktok-streak/releases/latest`). Double-click to run (standalone single-file executable, no Python installation required; on Windows SmartScreen click **More info -> Run anyway** if unsigned). Or run from Python 3.10+ source with `pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-gui.txt && python run_gui.py`.

### Step 2: Connect Your TikTok Account & Add Friends
1. Open the **Accounts** tab and click **Sign in via Browser (Recommended)** — or click **Import from Browser** to open the self-contained browser profile picker (`Chrome`, `Edge`, `Firefox`, `Zen`, with automatic `[v20]` detection and 1-click Guided Browser Login switch). Guided Browser Login opens an un-flagged Chrome/Edge window so Windows App-Bound Encryption (`v20`) does not block cookies.
2. Sign in to TikTok, wait for `/messages` to load, and click **I'm Logged In — Grab Now** (or wait for auto-capture). Click **Verify Session** in the card header to check inbox availability and hydrate regional routing cookies (`tt-target-idc`, `store-idc`) for US GitHub runners.
3. Add mutual friend `@username` handles or import CSV (`Import CSV`). Enable **Multi-Account** for multiple TikTok profiles with optional per-account content overrides.

### Step 3: Customize Content & Live 1:1 DM Preview (**Message & Media**)
1. In **Message & Media**, customize the streak text message, TikTok video share URL (`vt.tiktok.com` short links resolved automatically, verified live via **Check Link**), share count per friend, and optional custom photo.
2. Watch your exact payload and reactive Streak Pet points (`+7 pts/day`) update live inside the responsive **1:1 TikTok DM Preview** panel.

### Step 4: Configure Schedule & Deploy (**Automation**)
1. Open **Automation**, confirm your single-source timezone badge (editable in **Settings -> General & Alerts**), and choose `Local PC`, `GitHub Cloud`, or `Hybrid`.
2. For **GitHub Cloud**, sign in with 1-click GitHub Device Flow, keep **Private** enabled, review **Detected Bot Repositories** (select any existing bot row, pause/resume schedules, or pause duplicate active bots), choose off-peak schedule minutes such as `:15` or `:17`, confirm all 3 **Preflight** checks turn green, and click **Deploy to GitHub**.

### Step 5: Verify Safely & Monitor (**Run & Logs**)
In **Run & Logs**, pick one friend, optionally toggle **Show browser window** (automatically synced with **Automation** and enforcing `HEADFUL_GUARD_JS` inbox sidebar click-locking), click **Test 1 Friend**, and monitor **GitHub Cloud** status alongside **Recent Cloud Runs** and redacted **Live Logs**.

---

## 6. Under-the-Hood Architecture & Recipient Safety (`v1.3.0`)

1. **Strict `/messages`-Only Stealth (`src/browser.py`):** Injects cookies directly onto `https://www.tiktok.com` and navigates straight to `https://www.tiktok.com/messages?allow_label=true&lang=en&scene=business` without opening public profile or video watch pages (`secsdk-captcha` avoidance). Detects redirects to `/login` (`SessionExpiredError`) or `business-suite` (`InboxUnavailableError`).
2. **Recipient Verification & Unread-Safe Resolution (`src/actions.py`):**
   - `open_inbox_chat()` resolves threads using 3 exact-verified tiers: (1) React Fiber / DOM / network handle inspection of rendered rows, (2) in-inbox search input lookup, and (3) bounded read-only scan of *already-read* threads (explicitly skipping unread threads so notifications remain untouched and short prefixes like `M` never match `@max_demo` or `@sam_unread`).
   - `assert_active_chat_handle()` verifies the right-pane chat header `@username` before typing, immediately before `Keys.RETURN`, and before video share / photo modal submission, raising `RecipientMismatchError` if mismatched.
3. **Fail-Closed Per-Friend Gating & Template Isolation (`src/share.py`, `main.py`):** Clears WebSocket and HTTP `SEND_MESSAGE` template captures per friend (`reset_friend_send_capture`) and aborts share/photo sends for a friend immediately if text delivery fails.
4. **In-App Self-Updater (`gui/services/updater.py`):** Checks latest GitHub Release (`12h` startup cache + manual check), validates PE header (`MZ`) and API SHA-256 digest before launching a safe detached Windows batch `.exe` swap + rollback.

---

## 7. CLI & Manual Config Schema Reference

### CLI Commands
```bash
python run_gui.py                                           # Launch Windows Fluent Desktop GUI
python run_gui.py --smoke-test                              # Verify GUI startup headlessly and exit
python run_gui.py --run-bot --headful                       # Execute saved GUI config/secrets using visible browser
python run_gui.py --run-bot --only-account Main --only-friend user1
python main.py --headful --only-friend friend_username_1    # Direct CLI 1-friend smoke test
python fetch_friends.py                                     # Export mutual inbox handles to friends.csv
```

### GitHub Actions Repository Secrets (`.github/workflows/streak.yml`)
- `TIKTOK_SESSION_ID`: Single-account cookie (`sessionid`, full `Cookie:` header, or JSON cookie array)
- `FRIENDS_LIST`: Comma-separated friend handles
- `TIKTOK_ACCOUNTS_JSON`: Multi-account JSON configuration overriding single-account env
- `TIKTOK_COOKIES`: Global companion cookies merged safely below per-account cookies
- `MESSAGE`, `STREAK_VIDEO_URL` (`none` to disable), `SHARE_TIMES` (`0` to disable)
- `PHOTO_DATA_URL`, `PHOTO_PATH` (`none` to disable), `DISABLE_VIDEO`, `DISABLE_PHOTO`
- `DAILY_CAP`: Max friends messaged per account per run (`0` = unlimited)
- `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`: Optional completion alert target

---

## 8. Troubleshooting Matrix

| Error / Symptom | Root Cause | Solution |
|---|---|---|
| Browser profile shows `[v20]` | Chrome/Edge Windows App-Bound Encryption blocks disk cookie decryption | Use **Sign in via Browser (Recommended)** or **Paste Cookie Manually** |
| `SessionExpiredError` | Cookie expired or missing regional cookies (`tt-target-idc`, `store-idc`) on US GitHub runners | Click **Verify** on Accounts tab to auto-upgrade cookies, or re-sign in via Guided Browser Login |
| `InboxUnavailableError` | Account uses TikTok Business Suite where web `/messages` is disabled | Switch to a standard personal TikTok account |
| `RecipientMismatchError` | Active chat header did not match target `@username` | Automatic safeguard aborted delivery; re-verify handle spelling or do not click chats mid-run |
| `RateLimitError` | TikTok anti-spam rate limit banner detected | Pause bot 24h for cooldown and set a lower `DAILY_CAP` |
| Cloud run starts 1–4h late | GitHub Actions shared cron congestion at top of hour (`:00`) | Switch schedule minutes to `:15` or `:17` or use Local PC Task Scheduler |

---

## 9. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How does TikTok Streak Auto run for free without a server or VPS?**
A: When deployed in Cloud mode, it pushes `.github/workflows/streak.yml` and encrypted secrets (`PyNaCl` SealedBox) to a private GitHub repository under your own GitHub account. GitHub Actions then runs Chromium headlessly on GitHub's free cron runner minutes.

**Q: Does Chrome v20 encryption break this tool?**
A: No. Instead of failing on App-Bound Encrypted SQLite cookie blobs, Guided Browser Login launches your native Chrome/Edge cleanly and reads active session cookies via Chrome DevTools Protocol (`Storage.getCookies`) once `/messages` loads.

**Q: Can it accidentally send a streak message to the wrong friend?**
A: `v1.3.0` prevents misdelivery via right-pane `@username` header verification before typing, before pressing Enter, and before video/photo submission, unread-safe thread resolution, per-friend WebSocket/HTTP template isolation, and automatic sidebar click-locking in headful mode.

**Q: Will sending automated streaks trigger TikTok captchas?**
A: The runner avoids public profiles and video watch pages (common `secsdk-captcha` triggers) and operates strictly inside `/messages` using stealth browser flags and human-like typing intervals.

**Q: How do I stop duplicate messages if I deployed to two repositories?**
A: Open **Automation -> Detected Bot Repositories**. Any repository containing `streak.yml` is listed with Active/Paused status. Click **Pause Schedule** / pause extra schedules cleanly, or manage schedules directly from **Run & Logs**.
